saw_lines: Phone case buyers pick by model and then by feel, and they replace a case whenever they upgrade the phone.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a shopper checks if the case fits their exact phone.
Your 22 live ads show no proof number, so collect one, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 4 Nov 2026
points: None of your 22 ads shows a proof number, so a stranger scrolling past has no reason to trust the case. Collect one review count or orders shipped figure and open the next three ads with it on screen.

Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it, so a first time buyer sees no reason to act today. Put the free shipping answer in the first line of three new ads, ahead of the waterproof claim.
All 22 ads are video, so you have no stills for retargeting, where past viewers need a quick look at the fit. Shoot stills of the S26 Ultra and Pixel 11 Pro XL cases and run three to past viewers.

3 ads have run 60+ days, but 19 newer ads never reuse their opening, so a proven hook stays in one ad. Build the next three ads as variations of your oldest winner, keeping its opening and swapping case and scene.
